  agent_strength: 1.00

The Subtask Name: Information Retrieval and Verification

  agent_strength: 1.00

  agent_failure_modes:

      description: If the Planner repeatedly sends the same instructions without incorporating new search results, it may cause redundant loops.
      severity: 0.60

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebSurfer will output identical or near-identical results, preventing progress toward verification.
    - type: data_issue
      description: If the Planner provides incorrect URLs or vague extraction criteria, the WebSurfer may retrieve irrelevant data.
      severity: 0.70
      if_from_agent_wrong: The WebSurfer will fetch wrong pages or extract incomplete information.

- From_agent: WebSurfer

  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 1.00
  agent_explanation: The WebSurfer returns search results and page content, which the Planner analyzes to update its understanding and decide the next step.
  agent_failure_modes:

      description: If the WebSurfer fails to extract the correct sentences or misinterprets the visible text, the Planner will base its reasoning on false premises.
      severity: 0.85
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner may incorrectly conclude that the answer is unverified or wrong.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner might issue new instructions to search for non-existent information or fail to finalize the answer.
    - type: loop_issue
      description: If the WebSurfer repeatedly returns the same limited viewport content without scrolling or refining the search, it reinforces a loop.
      severity: 0.75
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner will continue to request the same information, leading to an infinite loop of identical outputs.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner will keep instructing the WebSurfer to re-fetch the same data, never reaching the final conclusion.
